scenes.text: One plugin update can break your whole site.
scenes.say: One plugin update can break your whole site. Here is the safe way.

scenes.title: Before you click Update
scenes.say: First, make a full backup. Note which plugins need updates. Pick a quiet time to do it.
Do not update everything at once. Update one plugin at a time, so you know which one caused a problem.

scenes.title: Check after each update
scenes.say: After each update, open your home page. Test a form or checkout. Look for error messages.

scenes.label: go back to your backup and try again later
scenes.say: If something breaks, restore your backup and try again later.
